top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.405(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The verification of liability insurance was not submitted timely to Child Care Regulation.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four children files were missing vaccinations, one child file was missing a health statement, one child file was missing the permission to have medical treatment, one child was missing start date,and  one child file was missing the address for pick up persons.  During the follow up inspection, children's files were missing immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.
